claim: The Bock Casemates are part of a 23 km underground tunnel system carved into the rock and received the Tripadvisor 2026 Travellers' Choice Award; address is Montée de Clausen, L-1343 Luxembourg.
quote: system of underground galleries and tunnels stretching over 23 km ... received Tripadvisor's 2026 Travellers' Choice Award ... Montée de Clausen, 1343 Luxembourg

claim: Bock Casemates open March 1 to November 2, 2026, 10:00-17:00 (to 18:00 in summer); adult ticket €8, Kulturpass €1.50.
quote: open from March 1 to November 2, 2026, with hours from 10:00-17:00, extending to 18:00 during summer months ... Adult tickets cost 8 EUR ... Kulturpass rate of €1.50

claim: Mudam (Park Dräi Eechelen, Kirchberg) opens Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00, Wed to 21:00 with free entry Wed 18:00-21:00; full price €10, reduced €7, free under 21 and for students.
quote: Tuesday–Sunday: 10:00–18:00 ... Wednesday: 10:00–21:00 ... Full price: €10 ... Reduced rate: €7 ... Free: Children under 21, students ... Wednesday 18:00 – 21:00

claim: Since 29 February 2020 all public transport in Luxembourg (trains, trams, RGTR/TICE/AVL buses) has been free for residents and tourists; only 1st-class rail still requires a ticket.
quote: Since 29 February 2020, public transport has been free for everybody, residents as well as tourists ... trains, trams and buses (RGTR, TICE, AVL). However, the only exception are tickets and subscriptions for the 1st class

claim: LuxembourgPass (formerly LuxembourgCard) gives free access to 80+ tourist sites; individual cards cost €14/1 day, €22/2 days, €31/3 days, family/group up to 5 €31/€54/€77.
quote: free access or access at reduced prices to more than 80 tourist sites ... €14 for one day, €22 for two days, and €31 for three days ... groups and families of up to five people, the cost is €31, €54, and €77

claim: Grand Ducal Palace summer tours run 18 July to 30 August 2026, in Luxembourgish/French/English/German; adults €18, children 4-12 €9, under 4 free; book via LCTO.
quote: from Saturday 18 July to Sunday 30 August 2026 ... Adults: €18.00 ... Children (4-12 years): €9.00 ... Luxemburgish, French, English, and German

claim: The Chemin de la Corniche, dubbed 'the most beautiful balcony of Europe' by Batty Weber, runs along 17th-century Spanish/French ramparts from the Bock promontory to the Holy Ghost Citadel overlooking the Alzette valley and Grund.
quote: the most beautiful balcony of Europe ... along the Alzette valley on the ramparts built by the Spaniards and the French in the 17th century, from the Bock Promontory up to the lower part of the Holy Ghost Citadel

claim: Philharmonie Luxembourg's 2026/27 season features Sir Simon Rattle with Bach at its centre, plus the atlântico festival and a John Coltrane centenary tribute.
quote: 2026/27 season featuring performances ranging from Sir Simon Rattle to Luxembourg's Duo Vershinina-Lee, with Bach taking center stage ... tributes to John Coltrane's 100th birthday

claim: MNHA/Nationalmusée um Fëschmaart's permanent collections are free; combined ticket with Musée Dräi Eechelen (Kirchberg) is €12 on the same day.
quote: The permanent exhibitions are free of charge ... admission to both museums (Musée Dräi Eechelen & Nationalmusée um Fëschmaart), valid on the same day: €12

claim: Notre-Dame Cathedral is open daily except during services with free admission; its crypt added 1935-37 holds the tomb of John the Blind and Grand Ducal family members.
quote: open daily, except during services, and admission is free ... crypt was added between 1935 and 1937 ... resting place of John the Blind, King of Bohemia and Count of Luxembourg, as well as deceased members of the Grand Ducal family

claim: Neumünster Abbey in the Grund, built in 1688 on the former Benedictine Altmünster site, is now a cultural centre hosting the European Institute of Cultural Routes plus concerts and exhibitions; the Saint-Esprit/Grund lift connects upper and lower town daily until 02:00 (04:00 Fri/Sat).
quote: Neumünster Abbey was built in 1688 ... home of the European Institute of Cultural Routes ... Grund elevator that connects Plateau du Saint-Esprit ... Sunday to Thursday from 6.30 am to 2 am and Fridays and Saturdays from 6.30 am to 4 am

claim: The Pétrusse Casemates have reopened after security works with new scenography and light installations; access 7 days a week every 15 min from 09:45 to 17:00 (last admission), entry at Place de la Constitution.
quote: After extensive enhancement and security works, the Pétrusse Casemates reopened with a cutting-edge scenography and mesmerising light installations ... 7 days a week, every 15 minutes, from 09:45 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

claim: Moutfort lies about 13 km from Luxembourg City centre, roughly a 12-minute drive, and is reachable by RGTR bus line 411.
quote: Moutfort to Luxembourg - 3 ways to travel via line 411 bus ... driving distance between Moutfort and Luxembourg is 8 miles, and it takes approximately 12 minutes
